reason: The oracle's commons/layout/_document.scss sets scroll-behavior: smooth on html. Decision 10 gives smooth scrolling only to a class that the docs page's script sets during a nav click, inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, and criterion 11 allows scroll-behavior: smooth nowhere else, so site/assets/css/common.css leaves html at auto from Phase 2; Phase 3's docs.js adds the class (PLAN.md Divergence categories: merge-layout, smooth scrolling).
notes: scroll-behavior is not inherited, so html is the one element that differs. Pico 2.1.1's and femto's prefers-reduced-motion: reduce rule sets it to auto on every element anyway, so under reduced motion the two sides agree.

reason: The oracle's body rows are auto auto 1fr auto, for the maintenance banner, header, main and footer, so at static-multipage, without the banner (Decision 5), the footer takes the 1fr track and an empty fourth track reads 0px (p1-shell-404-footer-track). common.css makes the rows auto 1fr auto, so main takes the 1fr track again: three tracks where the tag has four. On a page taller than its viewport the three tracks hold the same heights; on the 404 page at 800 to 1300 px the free space moves from the footer's track to main's, so the footer sits at the bottom of the window as on the oracle.
notes: One record per cell, on body. main and footer keep their own heights (align-items: start), so no other record shows the move; the screenshots do. The fix that Phase 1's p1-shell-404-footer-track and p1-shell-body-grid-rows name for Phase 2.

reason: The oracle's /docs/version-picker and its color routes load color-picker.css, which declares only the 20 unshaded --femto-color-<name> tokens, -light and -dark, and the .femto-background-<name> swatch classes. Its text is femto.colors.min.css's, so docs/menu.json loads that file there instead, as Decision 8's one docs page will on every section. It also declares the 19 shades of each color (50 to 950); this entry covers them. No computed style changes: no element on those routes uses a shade.
notes: One closed set of 380 names, two thirds of the 570 declared on a picker route; a closed-set surface entry may name up to 70% (tests/README.md, Divergence registry). A surface entry takes no selector or route; on /docs/colors both sides declare the shades (the oracle's color-utilities.css), so it matches only on the 20 picker routes.
